description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents... "Sans Souci," a charming pet-friendly retreat tucked away in Magnolia Cottages by the Sea along Scenic Highway 30A! This inviting 3-bedroom vacation home sleeps 8 and offers a wonderful setting for families and friends looking to enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of 30A. With beach access just a 3-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride away, days spent along the Gulf couldn't be easier. Spend sunny afternoons at the heated community pool, gather for dinner after a day exploring or take advantage of 4 included bikes to discover the area's local shops and restaurants. With a beautifully renovated kitchen, comfortable coastal living spaces and room for your four-legged family members, “Sans Souci” makes it easy to feel right at home. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Nearby Beach Access: Enjoy the sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters of 30A with beach access just a 3-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride from the home.Pet-Friendly Retreat: Bring your furry family members along for your 30A getaway and enjoy a vacation where everyone is welcome.Heated Community Pool: Spend sunny afternoons swimming, lounging poolside or enjoying a refreshing dip at the neighborhood's heated pool.4 Beach Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and its charming neighboring communities with 4 included bikes, perfect for discovering local restaurants, shops and scenic surroundings.Beautifully Renovated Kitchen: Enjoy preparing meals in an updated kitchen featuring stainless-steel appliances, sleek countertops and everything needed for gathering around the table.Comfortable Accommodations: Sleeps 8 guests across 3 inviting bedrooms, offering plenty of room for families and friends to relax and unwind.Prime 30A Location: Enjoy convenient access to local favorites like Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill for boutique shopping, exceptional dining and entertainment.Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “We had a wonderful time. The house was perfect and close to so many things!” - Lena W.⭐ "The house was perfect for our family vacation to 30a! Having the beach across the street and a short drive or bike ride to town was perfect. It will always be our go to spot!" - Peter S.⭐ " The house was great, a very easy walk to the beach and plenty of space. Kitchen was well stocked. We loved the bikes as well. We would definitely stay again!" - Tim W.*** LIVING AREA ***Step inside “Sans Souci” and settle into a bright, welcoming living space designed for spending time together. The open-concept layout brings the living, kitchen and dining areas together, making it easy to stay connected whether you're preparing dinner, catching up on the day's adventures or settling in for a movie night. Comfortable coastal furnishings and a relaxed atmosphere make this an inviting place to unwind after exploring 30A.Open-Concept Living Area: Spacious, inviting layout with comfortable seating and plenty of room for family gatherings, movie nights or simply relaxing together.Roku TV Entertainment: Enjoy streaming your favorite movies, shows and entertainment during cozy evenings at home.Coastal-Inspired Furnishings: Comfortable seating and beach-inspired details create a warm, relaxed atmosphere that makes settling into vacation feel effortless.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Whether you're preparing a leisurely breakfast before heading out or gathering everyone for a homemade dinner, the beautifully renovated kitchen makes cooking and entertaining a pleasure. Brand-new stainless-steel appliances, sleek countertops and a fully equipped kitchen provide everything needed to prepare your favorite meals. Gather around the dining table or pull up a stool at the breakfast bar for casual conversations over coffee.Renovated Kitchen: Beautifully updated with stainless-steel appliances, sleek countertops and plenty of space for preparing meals throughout your stay.Fully Equipped for Cooking: Stocked with essential cookware, utensils and kitchen tools, making everything from quick breakfasts to family dinners easy to prepare.Spacious Dining Accommodations: Enjoy seating for 6 at the dining table, plus 4 additional bar stools for casual meals, morning coffee or gathering while dinner is prepared.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***After a full day exploring 30A, retreat to one of three comfortable bedrooms designed to help everyone relax and recharge. The first floor features a cozy Queen bedroom and a bunk room that's perfect for younger guests, while the upstairs Primary Suite offers a private retreat with balcony access and a beautifully appointed bathroom. With comfortable sleeping arrangements for up to 8 guests, “Sans Souci” offers a welcoming space for families and friends to enjoy their time together.1st FloorQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities & walk-in showerBunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, flat-screen TV/DVD player and convenient access to the dedicated hall bathroom.Guest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combo, conveniently located for guests staying in the bunk room.2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities & walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Enjoy the laid-back coastal atmosphere of “Sans Souci” from the comfort of its inviting outdoor spaces. Start your morning with coffee on the porch, fire up the grill for a relaxed evening meal or enjoy your favorite music while soaking in the fresh Florida air. Thoughtful conveniences throughout the home make it easy to enjoy every part of your stay.Inviting Outdoor Porch: Relax with your morning coffee or enjoy an evening outdoors while listening to your favorite music on the provided Bluetooth speaker.Outdoor Grill: Prepare fresh seafood, family favorites or an easy dinner on the grill and enjoy a relaxed evening together.Outdoor Shower: Conveniently located near the side entrance, offering a refreshing place to rinse off after a day enjoying the beach.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tucked away in the charming Magnolia Cottages by the Sea community, “Sans Souci” offers a peaceful retreat in the heart of Seacrest West. With beach access just a 3-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride away, it's easy to spend your mornings along the Gulf before heading back to relax by the heated community pool. Hop on one of the 4 included bikes to explore Scenic Highway 30A or venture out to discover the wonderful dining, shopping and entertainment that make this area so special. From the beautiful architecture of Alys Beach to the inviting restaurants and boutiques of Rosemary Beach, there's always something to enjoy nearby.Nearby Beach Access: Just a 3-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride from the home, enjoy convenient access to the beautiful sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters of 30A.Heated Community Pool: Spend leisurely afternoons swimming, soaking up the Florida sunshine or relaxing poolside in the welcoming Magnolia Cottages by the Sea community.4 Beach Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and its neighboring communities while enjoying the beautiful coastal scenery along the way.Alys Beach: Discover this stunning coastal community known for its iconic white architecture, beautifully landscaped surroundings and exceptional dining experiences.The Big Chill: Enjoy an evening of live music, outdoor entertainment and delicious dining options at this popular gathering place for families and friends.Rosemary Beach: Wander through charming cobblestone streets lined with boutique shops, inviting cafés and wonderful local restaurants.*** PET POLICY ***Maximum of 2 pets allowed.Pets are not allowed on furniture or beds.Must be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dog.Non-refundable pet fee: $250 + tax.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Pet-friendly with a non-refundable $250 fee (up to 2 pets, restrictions apply).Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection, and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 83392STRO #: STR-083392 Read less
